title: Our Favorite Meals
text:
Pizza is my favorite meal. I eat it with my cousins on Saturday. We sit at a big table. The pizza is hot and good.

Breakfast is my least favorite meal. I eat bread and drink orange juice. My little brother likes cereal and eats it fast.

questions.text: What is the narrator's favorite meal?
What does the narrator drink for breakfast?
How does the narrator probably feel on pizza day?
What can we tell about the narrator's family?
options: They spend time together at meals.

vocabulary.definition: the one you like the most
the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning
the children of your aunts and uncles
a piece of furniture with a flat top, used for eating

paragraph_translations: Pizza é minha refeição favorita. Eu como com meus primos no sábado. Nós sentamos em uma mesa grande. A pizza está quente e boa.
Café da manhã é minha refeição menos favorita. Eu como pão e bebo suco de laranja. Meu irmão mais novo gosta de cereal e come rápido.
